title: The Family: A Proclamation to the World
meta_description: Official proclamation by the First Presidency and the Council of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, declaring the doctrine of the family as central to God's plan. Read by President Gordon B. Hinckley at the General Relief Society Meeting on September 23, 1995.
study_intro: In September 1995, President Gordon B. Hinckley read 'The Family: A Proclamation to the World' at the General Relief Society Meeting. This proclamation, issued by the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, declares the doctrine of the family, marriage, gender, parental roles, and the sanctity of life. It has become one of the most widely cited Church documents in general conference, manuals, and Church education.
authors: The Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
